component.name: Gitpulsar
component.summary: Fast native Git client for GNOME

description.p: Gitpulsar is a complete Git client built natively for GNOME. Written in Rust with GTK4 and libadwaita, it stays fast and lightweight while giving you the full Git workflow without ever leaving the keyboard or reaching for the terminal.

Unlike browser-wrapped Git apps, Gitpulsar is a single small binary that follows your system theme, respects your accent color preferences, and feels like a first-class GNOME application. It runs offline, sends nothing to the cloud, and uses zero telemetry.
Why choose Gitpulsar:

ul.li: Native GNOME look and feel — libadwaita widgets, dark and light themes, dynamic colors
Multi-repository workspace — open a folder, see all repos with live status indicators (modified, untracked, ahead of remote)
Adaptive layout — works from a 4K monitor down to a 360 px phone screen (Phosh, postmarketOS)
Low CPU and memory — Rust core with smart background polling that pauses when the window isn't focused
No telemetry, no account, no cloud — your code stays on your machine

description.p: What you can do:

ul.li: Browse history with a paginated commit log, search, and an integrated branch graph
Stage and unstage by file, by hunk, or by individual line — with drag and drop
Commit with conventional commit prefixes (feat, fix, docs…) and one-click Co-Authored-By trailers
Undo and redo staging operations and even file discards
Resolve merge conflicts in a three-panel visual editor
Run interactive rebase with reorder, squash, fixup, reword, edit, and drop actions
Annotate any file with blame to see who changed each line
View per-file commit history to debug regressions
Clone a repository from a URL with a built-in dialog
Manage remotes — add, rename, remove, and edit URLs
Push and delete tags on the remote, create lightweight or annotated tags
Export commits as patches and apply patches with git am or git apply
Browse the reflog to recover from accidental reset, rebase, or branch operations
Manage stashes, submodules, and worktrees from the sidebar
Edit .gitignore inside the app
Use the full keyboard — shortcuts for every common action and Tab-cycling across panels

description.p: Fixes per-file Stage/Unstage/Discard/Blame/History buttons that did nothing in the changes view. Empty commits are now rejected by default (tick "Allow empty" to override). Staged files show a green checkmark next to the filename and section headers carry live file counts so the Staged list is obvious. New features: export commit as archive (tar.gz/tar/zip), export branch graph as PNG, and bisect UI with Good/Bad/Skip/Reset controls.
New: Branch compare dialog, Restore file from a past commit (in file history), and word-level diff highlighting within modified lines.
Improved app description and keywords for better discoverability on Flathub. New summary: "Fast native Git client for GNOME". The app itself is unchanged.
New: Reflog browser, Remote management dialog, Co-Author trailer helper. Repo indicator colors now use a custom CSS provider so they are unaffected by the user's GNOME accent color.
Fix: repository indicator dots now use explicit colors (blue for untracked, yellow for tracked changes), so they stay correct regardless of the user's GNOME accent color.

New features: Clone repository from URL, per-file commit history, tag push/delete on remote, export/apply patches. Color-coded repo indicators (green/yellow/blue). Untracked files now counted in dirty check.
Performance: skip background refresh when window is inactive, saving 10-15% CPU. Auto-refresh on window focus. Throttled workspace scanning. Adaptive AdwDialog API for mobile. Icon footprint fix.
Migrated all dialogs to adaptive AdwDialog API for mobile support. Improved header bar layout on narrow screens with sidebar toggle buttons always visible.
Redesigned icon with GNOME HIG squircle shape, pulsar rays on the branch node, and better contrast on dark backgrounds.
Improved Flathub metadata: rewritten app description, pinned screenshot URLs to version tag, updated branding colors and keywords.
Redesigned app icon to fit GNOME HIG safe zone. Updated screenshots to 1000x700 for Flathub quality guidelines.

Mobile-adaptive layout with three-tier responsive breakpoints. Added blame view, integrated graph tab, inline commit diffs, and custom GNOME icons. Slide animations for expanding panels. Bundled git CLI in Flatpak sandbox.
Fixed unpushed commit indicators and sidebar not updating after push, pull, or fetch.
Three-way conflict resolution editor, line-level staging, conventional commit prefixes, keyboard navigation, and theme-aware diff colors.
Syntax-highlighted diffs, split staged and unstaged lists with drag-and-drop, partial hunk staging, undo and redo, paginated commits, parallel workspace scanning, and performance optimizations.
Initial release with commit browsing, staging, branches, tags, stash, remote operations, and adaptive layout.
